links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with vs without AI assistance by endoscopist sex, in real workflow
links.effect: AI improved ADR among male endoscopists (AOR 1.166, 95% CI 1.064 to 1.278; p = 0.001) but had no significant effect for females; male ADR rose to 28.77% vs female without AI 30.05%.
links.quote: AI assistance improved ADR among male endoscopists (AOR 1.166, 95% CI 1.064 to 1.278; p = 0.001) but had no significant effect for females.

screen.reason: Retrospective cohort study evaluating real-world clinical deployment of AI-assisted colonoscopy across different endoscopist characteristics; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice modification.
